redaction: Random isolated-session directories replaced by <isolated-session>. The retained text contains deterministic fixture content and host lifecycle/render observations, not private conversations or credentials.

runtimeExperiment.sdkSessions: In-memory settings and sessions, same inline extension name, distinct /ui handlers. No SDK tool execution or TUI rendering.

recordFormat: Parsed observations from the named throwaway scripts. Terminal text is retained unchanged except directory redaction. The pinned export log mislabeled String.length as bytes; exportSizeCorrection records the original value and the measured UTF-8 size. Empty stderr fields refer to final successful runs; earlier candidate failures are described in the paired report.
limits: Candidate experiments only. Production is unchanged and its two history regressions still fail.
The session-byte check covers the pre-existing fixture session file at each observed stage, not all filesystem activity or full UI-on/off equivalence.
Grouping uses only Read without explicit offset/limit, with compact-stage captures and scripted disclosure assertions. No Web grouping or full lifecycle acceptance.
Simple custom Grep/Find HTML renderers and original exported results were checked on pinned Pi; native Read HTML and production group export are not validated.

Runtime proof covers same-module SDK ownership and deactivation under two teardown orders and one foreign wrapper. No concurrent SDK UI, different configurations/module copies, or long-term wrapper/memory acceptance.
No performance or live-model endurance result is established by these probes.
